ev.q: a total of 41 cases of Salmonella Bredeney infections were identified in 20 states
63% of patients were aged <10 years, and 60% were male
10 (28%) were reported to have been hospitalized
25 (78%) had eaten a Trader Joe's brand Valencia peanut butter product
10 (28%) were reported to have been hospitalized
to investigate an outbreak of Salmonella Bredeney infections associated with exposure to peanut products
